source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to attack a completely new LeanFrontier target outside the roadmap. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT screened Varignon's theorem against the live LeanFrontier fork and pinned Mathlib v4.34.0 and found no existing Varignon theorem or equivalent named quadrilateral-midpoint parallelogram statement. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the affine formulation that the opposite side vectors of the midpoint quadrilateral are equal in pairs. The proof uses Mathlib's midpoint_vsub_midpoint and midpoint_eq_smul_add lemmas and affine torsor cancellation identities.
